claims.text: Neostigmine (short-acting AChE inhibitor) = drug of choice for ACPO.
claims.quote: Neostigmine, a short-acting acetylcholinesterase inhibitor, is the drug of choice for treatment of ACPO.
It is recommended that patients be on a continuous cardiac monitor during administration and for 30 additional minutes after administration.
Atropine for symptomatic bradycardia should be available per ACLS guidelines.
Some clinicians use IV neostigmine (which requires cardiac monitoring) to treat Ogilvie syndrome.
